answer: The vault is public, so padding it with copies shows up as duplicated leaves on the marble. Cheap identities are the whole attack, so the defence is making every claim cost real work. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the crystal of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. Written in a short declarative sentences register, it stays short. The design leans on honeypot tasks with known-bad answers, taxed when attestations come from one subnet, every claim is re-checked by someone with nothing to gain.
